description: This file defines TLV (Type-Length-Value) class structures related to VHT (Very High Throughput) Capabilities in the Wi-Fi Basic Map (wfa_map), including class definitions, nested structures, and bit fields.

classes.name: tlvApVhtCapabilities
classes.description: Class representing VHT Capabilities of an Access Point, including type, radio ID, supported MCS rates, and capability flags.

classes.name: sFlags1
classes.description: Structure holding flags related to supported spatial streams and support for short GI at various bandwidths.

classes.name: sFlags2
classes.description: Structure indicating support for 80/80MHz and 160MHz channels, beamforming capabilities, and reserved bits.
